name: Pterodactyl Next.js Egg
author: Mark7625
description:
Pterodactyl Next.js Egg

Deploy Next.js apps on Pterodactyl. Pulls your site from Git on every restart, runs next build + next start, and proxies traffic through Nginx. Supports SSR, API routes, and middleware. Includes Cloudflare Tunnel, Certbot SSL, cron jobs, and egg auto-updates.

Key Features:

✅ Next.js build & start (next build / next start)
✅ Nginx reverse proxy for SSR and API routes
✅ Website repo, branch, and token configuration
✅ Git pull on restart
✅ Cloudflare Tunnel + Certbot SSL
✅ Optional static export mode

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash EGG_REPO="https://github.com/Mark7625/custom-pterodactyl-eggs.git" EGG_BRANCH="nextjs" WEBSITE_REPO="${WEBSITE_REPO:-${GIT_ADDRESS:-}}" WEBSITE_BRANCH="${WEBSITE_BRANCH:-${GIT_BRANCH:-}}" WEBSITE_TOKEN="${WEBSITE_TOKEN:-${ACCESS_TOKEN:-}}" WEBSITE_USERNAME="${WEBSITE_USERNAME:-${USERNAME:-}}" echo -e "[SETUP] Install packages" apt-get update -qq > /dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -qq > /dev/null 2>&1 -y git wget git ls-remote "$EGG_REPO" "refs/heads/${EGG_BRANCH}" | awk '{print $1}' | head -1 > /mnt/server/VERSION cd /mnt/server echo -e "[SETUP] Create folders" mkdir -p logs tmp www public echo "[Git] Cloning egg repository '${EGG_REPO}' (branch: ${EGG_BRANCH})" git clone --branch "$EGG_BRANCH" --single-branch "$EGG_REPO" /mnt/server/gtemp > /dev/null 2>&1 \ && echo "[Git] Repository cloned successfully." \ || { echo "[Git] Error: Default repository clone failed."; exit 21; } echo "[Git] Copying egg files from repository." cp -r /mnt/server/gtemp/nginx /mnt/server || { echo "[Git] Error: Copying 'nginx' folder failed."; exit 22; } cp -r /mnt/server/gtemp/modules /mnt/server || { echo "[Git] Error: Copying 'modules' folder failed."; exit 22; } cp /mnt/server/gtemp/start-modules.sh /mnt/server || { echo "[Git] Error: Copying 'start-modules.sh' file failed."; exit 22; } cp /mnt/server/gtemp/LICENSE /mnt/server || { echo "[Git] Error: Copying 'LICENSE' file failed."; exit 22; } chmod +x /mnt/server/start-modules.sh find /mnt/server/modules -type f -name "*.sh" -exec chmod +x {} \; rm -rf /mnt/server/gtemp if [ -z "${WEBSITE_REPO}" ]; then echo "[Website] Info: WEBSITE_REPO is not set." echo "[Website] Website deploy is disabled during install." cat > /mnt/server/www/index.html <<'HTML' Next.js Egg

Pterodactyl Next.js Egg

Set WEBSITE_REPO to your Next.js repository and restart the server.

HTML ln -sfn /mnt/server/www /mnt/server/public else if [[ ${WEBSITE_REPO} != *.git ]]; then WEBSITE_REPO="${WEBSITE_REPO}.git" fi if [ -n "${WEBSITE_TOKEN}" ]; then GIT_DOMAIN=$(echo "${WEBSITE_REPO}" | sed -E 's|https://([^/]+)/.*|\1|') GIT_REPO_PATH=$(echo "${WEBSITE_REPO}" | sed -E 's|https://[^/]+/(.*)|\1|') AUTH_USER="${WEBSITE_USERNAME:-x-access-token}" CLONE_URL="https://${AUTH_USER}:${WEBSITE_TOKEN}@${GIT_DOMAIN}/${GIT_REPO_PATH}" echo "[Website] Using authenticated Git access." else CLONE_URL="${WEBSITE_REPO}" echo "[Website] Using anonymous Git access." fi rm -rf /mnt/server/www mkdir -p /mnt/server/www if [ -n "${WEBSITE_BRANCH}" ]; then git clone --branch "${WEBSITE_BRANCH}" --single-branch "${CLONE_URL}" /mnt/server/www > /dev/null 2>&1 \ && echo "[Website] Repository cloned successfully (branch '${WEBSITE_BRANCH}')." \ || { echo "[Website] Error: git clone failed (branch '${WEBSITE_BRANCH}')."; exit 14; } else git clone "${CLONE_URL}" /mnt/server/www > /dev/null 2>&1 \ && echo "[Website] Repository cloned successfully." \ || { echo "[Website] Error: git clone failed."; exit 14; } fi fi echo -e "[DONE] Everything has been installed successfully" echo -e "[INFO] You can now start the Next.js server"

variables.name: Enable Auto-Update
variables.description: Check for egg infrastructure updates on startup

variables.name: Force Auto-Update
variables.description: Automatically apply egg updates without confirmation

variables.name: Node.js Version
variables.description: Node.js version matching your Docker image (22 or 20)

variables.name: Website Repository
variables.description:
Git URL of your Next.js project
I.E. https://github.com/user/my-nextjs-site

variables.name: Website Branch
variables.description: Branch to deploy from your Next.js repo

variables.name: Website Access Token
variables.description:
Personal Access Token for private repos.
Leave blank for public repositories.

variables.name: Website Git Username
variables.description:
Git username for private repo auth.
Default: x-access-token (GitHub PATs)

variables.name: Enable Website Deploy
variables.description:
Pull Next.js repo updates on every restart.
0 = false
1 = true (default)

variables.name: Enable Next.js Build & Start
variables.description:
Install deps, next build, and next start on every restart.
0 = false
1 = true (default)

variables.name: Install Command
variables.description: Command to install dependencies before build

variables.name: Build Command
variables.description: Next.js production build command

variables.name: Start Command
variables.description:
Next.js production start command.
Set to none for static export only.

variables.name: Serve Mode
variables.description:
How to serve the built Next.js app.
node = Nginx proxies to Next.js server (SSR/API — recommended)
static = serve static export files only (requires output: export)

variables.name: Next.js Port
variables.description:
Internal port Next.js listens on (default 3000).
Nginx proxies your server port to this.

variables.name: Static Export Directory
variables.description:
Output folder for static export mode only.
Default: out (Next.js static export)

variables.name: Enable LogCleaner Module
variables.description: Run log cleanup on container startup

variables.name: Enable Cloudflare Tunnel
variables.description: Start Cloudflared tunnel on startup

variables.name: Cloudflared Tunnel Token
variables.description: Cloudflare Tunnel token

variables.name: Enable Cron Module
variables.description: Enable cron job scheduling

variables.name: Cron Config File
variables.description: Path to crontab configuration file

variables.name: Enable Certbot SSL
variables.description:
Enable Certbot SSL certificate management
0 = false
1 = true

variables.name: Certbot Email
variables.description: Email for Let's Encrypt notifications

variables.name: Certbot Domain
variables.description: Primary domain for SSL certificate

variables.name: Certbot Webroot Path
variables.description: Document root for webroot validation

variables.name: Certbot Staging Mode
variables.description:
Use Let's Encrypt staging server
0 = Production
1 = Staging

variables.name: Certbot Force Renewal
variables.description:
Force certificate renewal
0 = renew when needed
1 = force renewal
